title: ChatLab AI
emptyDescription: AI calls local analysis tools as needed and only sends the redacted data required for your current question to the model provider.
footer: AI can make mistakes. Verify important conclusions.

config.title: Configure Web AI
config.description: Web WASM calls the model provider directly from your browser. Requests do not pass through a ChatLab server.
config.apiKeyReplace: Enter again to replace the saved key
config.required: Enter an API URL, model, and API Key
config.keyStorageWarning: The API Key is encrypted and stored in this browser across refreshes. Browser-local encryption cannot protect against malicious scripts that already control this page.
config.corsWarning: Only OpenAI-compatible services that allow browser CORS requests are supported. A connection failure may mean the provider blocks direct browser access.
config.removeConfirm: Remove the model configuration and saved API Key?
config.removed: Model configuration and API Key removed

errors.AUTH: The API Key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: The request was rate-limited or has insufficient quota. Try again later.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The model was not found. Check the model name.
errors.TIMEOUT: The model request timed out. Try again.
errors.NETWORK_OR_CORS: The request was blocked by the network or browser CORS policy. Confirm that the provider supports direct browser access.
errors.FINISH_LENGTH: The response reached its length limit and may be incomplete. Continue the conversation or regenerate it.
errors.FINISH_CONTENT_FILTER: The model provider stopped the response because of its content policy. The response may be incomplete.
errors.FINISH_TOOL_CALLS: This turn reached its tool-call limit and may be incomplete. Try again.
errors.FINISH_UNKNOWN: The model did not finish normally. The response may be incomplete; try again.
